requirements.text: The page MUST render the spec as a dossier that mirrors the canonical file layout (id, name, description, date, status, metadata, spec, design, tasks, review) top-down.

scenarios.then: sections appear in canonical order with status visible

requirements.text: The question vocabulary MUST grow additively: kind (open|choice), options, default, and an honest 'I don't know' answer recorded as unknown while keeping the question blocking. Frozen packs stay valid.

scenarios.then: the options are selectable and the default is preselected
the question shows answered-unknown and still gates closure

requirements.text: A new admission command MUST land a question's answer: question id, text or unknown, a human claim (refused otherwise), stamped at, status updated by machine rules only.

scenarios.given: loom answer with a non-human claim
scenarios.then: refused with the A7 shape error

requirements.text: The owner MUST get one normative approval act for the spec as a whole, offered only when no open questions remain, recorded with a human claim and timestamp; its representation in the frozen vocabulary MUST be additive (Q-A decides the mechanism).
The page SHOULD show what changed since the owner's last visit (rounds), drawn from revision history.
Interview events (answer, unknown, choice, approve) MUST follow one published schema and MUST be written to a durable event file any agent can read (Q-B decides shape and home).

scenarios.then: each event carries kind, question or scope, by, and at

requirements.text: The harness adapter MUST run a local server (localhost bind, no auth, disclosed) that serves the page, routes every event through machine admission, and waits like an interrupt while the owner interviews (Q-C decides wait semantics).

The interview SHOULD be keyboard-first (navigate, answer, and finish without a mouse) AND pointer-complete (every act also reachable by mouse: click options, click through the wizard, click approve); a progress ring shows the derived deliverable stage.
The adapter contract MUST be documented (receive events, apply admission, report state) and the page MUST NOT import or call loom: it binds to the event vocabulary only.

constraints.text: Frozen packs never rewrite; the loader dual-reads (established, spec-layout CON-1).
Vocabulary and schema changes are additive only (status-vocabulary frozen rev 8; approval must fit without breaking frozen packs).
Answers and approval land only through machine admission with human claims; never raw file writes.
The page binds to events, not to loom (owner Q-2: must survive extraction to LangChain/LangGraph/custom platforms).
v1 is local only: localhost bind, single owner, no auth, disclosed plainly (owner Q-8).
The platform interrupt is NOT solved here; only the adapter contract is published (owner Q-3).

clarifications.question: How does spec approval live in the vocabulary? An additive lifecycle value, a sub-state, or a first-class accepted_by field? This touches the frozen status model (one-way door).
Event file shape and home: name, format tag, per-initiative or per-session, JSON lines or array?
Interrupt semantics for the waiting command: block until complete, timeout, or detach-and-resume?
Question kinds in v1: strictly open and choice, or also yes/no, number, date?

out_of_scope: brief authoring UI (the brief is a finalized file)
design/task tabs and whole-initiative surface (later waves)

design.approach: Events are the seam. The page renders and emits; the harness adapter consumes and admits; the platform adapter is a documented contract. The engine grows the question vocabulary and the approval act additively.

decisions.decision: Full chain scope: a finalized Feature Brief (markdown) is the input; analyze births the spec; the interview page carries the Conversation.
decisions.because: Owner Q-1a: the journey starts at the brief. Authoring UI stays out (bounded).

decisions.decision: The command is loom interview; the surface (page, events, adapter) must survive extraction from the harness into an agentic platform.
decisions.because: Owner Q-2: accepts the name, conditions it on portability to LangChain/LangGraph/custom platforms.

decisions.decision: Adapter architecture: the page emits events (answer, unknown, choice, approve); v1 ships the harness adapter; the platform adapter is a published contract, not code.
decisions.because: Owner Q-3: hook/interrupt locally, open adapter for platforms; do not solve the platform interrupt.

decisions.decision: loom answer is the admission command for questions, mirroring loom accept: human claim required, at stamped, machine rules only.
decisions.because: Owner Q-4: questions finally get the path decisions already have.

decisions.decision: Question vocabulary grows additively: kind (open|choice), options, default, and the honest unknown that keeps blocking.
decisions.because: Owner Q-5; frozen packs stay valid (CON-2).

decisions.decision: Phase model: derived deliverable stages stay machine-owned; one new normative act is added, spec approval, offered when no open questions remain.
decisions.because: Owner Q-6c: the owner's gate is the approval moment, not hand-set stages.

decisions.decision: Rounds: the page shows what changed since the owner's last visit, drawn from revision history.
decisions.because: Owner Q-7: rounds are first-class (crit.md lesson).

decisions.decision: v1 surface is local only: localhost bind, single owner, no auth, disclosed; auth becomes a platform-adapter concern.
v1 creative cuts: keyboard-first wizard and the progress ring; point-at-line comments are the v2 headline.
Lifespan: v1 is the spec ceremony (render, interview, approval); the page architecture leaves room for design, tasks, and close later.
decisions.because: Owner Q-10: rec accepted, pluggable for the platform future.

decisions.decision: Spec approval lives as a first-class header group, date.approved {at, by}, the twin of date.closed. The lifecycle enum (active, complete) is untouched; the representation is additive to the schema; the derived stage reads it and is never hand-set.
decisions.because: Owner accepted the recommendation (2026-10-09): zero state-machine change against the frozen vocabulary, reads chronologically in the header, mirrors the close ceremony exactly.

decisions.decision: The event file is docs/specs/<slug>/interview.jsonl: append-only JSON Lines. First line is a header {"format": "specweb-events/0.1"}; every following line is one event carrying kind, q (where scoped), by, at.
decisions.because: Owner accepted the recommendation (2026-10-09): JSONL appends without re-reading, replays line by line, tails well for agents.

decisions.decision: The waiting command blocks until the interview completes; Ctrl-C (SIGINT) escapes cleanly. Every admission persists on the spot, so an escape loses nothing. No timeout, no detach: those are platform-adapter territory.
decisions.because: Owner accepted the recommendation (2026-10-09): simplest honest v1; the machine never holds unsaved state.

decisions.decision: Question kinds in v1: open and choice only. Yes/no is a two-option choice; number and date wait until asked for.
decisions.because: Owner accepted the recommendation (2026-10-09): smallest vocabulary that carries the interview.

designs.title: The event vocabulary and the event file
designs.detail: Events: answer {q, text, by}, unknown {q, by}, choice {q, option, by}, approve {by}; each stamped at. A format-tagged durable file (shape per Q-B) records the stream; any agent that reads a file can replay the interview.

designs.title: The harness adapter
designs.detail: loom interview runs a localhost server: serves the page with an embedded spec snapshot, receives events, routes each through admission (loom answer, the approval act), writes the event file, and waits like an interrupt (semantics per Q-C) until the interview completes.

designs.title: The adapter contract (the open seam)
designs.detail: The published contract for platforms: receive events, apply admission, report state. The page binds to the event vocabulary only (grep-verifiable); a platform implements the contract on its own interrupt.

designs.title: The approval act
designs.detail: One normative owner acceptance of the spec as a whole: offered only with zero open questions, recorded with a human claim and timestamp. Vocabulary representation is additive (Q-A decides: lifecycle value, sub-state, or field); the derived stage reads it, never hand-set.

designs.title: The page
designs.detail: Single-page render mirroring the canonical layout; the interview is a keyboard-first wizard (one question in focus, options selectable, I-don't-know always available); a progress ring shows the derived stage; a rounds strip shows changes since the last visit from revision history.

designs.title: The question vocabulary extension
designs.detail: Clarifications grow additive fields: kind (open|choice; more per Q-D), options, default; answers record the honest unknown that keeps the question blocking. The admission command (FR-3) is the only write path.
